acquisition method: The data-dependent program used for data acquisition
cleavage agent: Sequencing grade trypsin (Promega) in 50 mM Ambic was added
collision energy: HCD fragmentation with a normalized collision energy of 32... HCD fragmentation with a normalized collision energy of 30
fragmentation method: HCD fragmentation with a normalized collision energy of 32
instrument: coupled to a Fusion mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)... coupled to Q-Exactive orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
mass analyzer: LTQ analysis using the rapid scan setting... and orbitrap analyzer at 17,500 resolution
precursor tolerance: m/z error tolerances of 10 ppm for peptide ions

ptm: carbamidomethylation of cysteine (fixed); deamidation of asparagine and glutamine (variable); oxidation of methionine (variable)
